title: Adaptive Journey Side Quests
changes: Fixed Japan Ready loading after the single-path Journey change removed its campaign chooser buttons.
Japan Ready remains a separate path with its existing scenarios, conversations and cheat sheet.
Journey remains a single guided lesson path with the current lesson, learning history and upcoming path visible together.
A lesson that falls below the existing mastery checkpoint now inserts a required side quest before the same lesson is retried.
The side quest is selected from the learner's weakest recent skill where enough evidence is available.
Side quests are represented as required Journey steps rather than separate destinations; completing the side quest returns the learner to the repeated lesson.
Completed Journey lessons continue to contribute to learning history, while completed lessons remain reviewable.
